notes.title: v1.0 launches!
notes.notes:

notes.title: Fast Forward to v0.5.1
notes.notes:
Just small changes this week. Give the new Fast Forward behavior a try; it helps to be able to quickly press and release the key to double the game speed. This is actually how I had a development-tool shortcut set-up, and since it just felt better, I made the Fast-Forward button function the same way while preserving it's "click-to-toggle" functionality.

Orbit: Satellite Defense is on track for it's release date of [b]March 26th, 2018[/b] grab the game now while it's still at an Early Access [b]discount[/b]!

notes.title: Score Obsessed v0.4.6
notes.notes:
If you're as obsessed with scores and statistics as I am, you'll love the new tweaks in Orbit: Satellite Defense this week. You can now see your cumulative score for each world of the Campaign tallied on its sub-menu, and your score for the full Campaign shown on its respective menu. Plus, you get a nice [b]Completion[/b] star for every Campaign world in which you've earned all 15 Stars. Also, [i]at long last[/i], you can now see your local high-score for each of the Endless Modes!

[h1]v0.4.6 Release Notes:[/h1]
[list][*]Campaign Scores are now tallied per world and displayed on the Campaign sub-menu[/*][*][b]Completion Stars[/b] have been added to the Campaign sub-menu to indicate when you have earned a 3 Star rating on every Level for that World[/*][*]The Campaign Sub-Menu now displays your cumulative Campaign Score and total Stars[/*][*]Endless Modes now display the highest Score you reached and the furthest Wave you made it to[/*][*][b]Fixed Game load Errors[/b]:[list][*]Cavitation Bubbles went the wrong direction when they were targeting the Planet[/*][*]Enemies who were in Retreat state would continue moving towards the planet and pass through it[/*][/list][/*][*]Fixed Highscore screen displaying Congratulations message even if player had failed the level[/*][/list]
Look forward to another update next week!

notes.title: Unlimited Endless Mode! v0.4.5
notes.notes:
Mostly internal updates to Orbit: Satellite Defense this week. For a taste of how OSD [i]used to[/i] play, check out the new "Unlimited" Endless Mode which lets you construct as many of each type of Satellite as you want. I no longer regard this to be the ideal way to play Orbit, but it is a unique way of playing the game, and I didn't want to crop it out entirely for those who prefer it.

[h1]v0.4.5 Release Notes:[/h1]
[list][*][b]Updated[/b] Manual to include more details about Campaign Scoring[/*][*][b]Score pop-up[/b]; when an enemy is defeated, the number of points it was worth is shown[/*][*][b]Reclassified[/b] "Challenge Modes" as additional "Endless" Modes; "Challenges" will be added later, and will not be Endless (or random)[/*][*]Added [b]New Endless Mode[/b]: Unlimited[list][*]No limit on the number of Satellites which can be produced[/*][*]Shield Satellite can be built[/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Level Objectives! v0.4.4
notes.notes:
This latest build of [i]Orbit: Satellite Defense[/i] is a major milestone towards online leaderboards. This required an exhaustive amount of play-testing and restructuring, but each level has been evaluated and given 3 score thresholds which you can try to reach to earn a 3-Star rating. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31854967/50003687bf359524e8c5876eb845a7f1d9125628.png[/img]

notes.title: Early v0.4.2 Update!
notes.notes:
Done slightly ahead of schedule; the latest Build of OSD is live NOW along with a brand-new game mode! It's accessible right from the main menu, and I hope you give [b]Warp Mode[/b] (called "Range Limit" in-game) a try! This new mode was inspired by feedback from players on Steam.
